messages:
alex: Heads-up — planning to onboard halcyon-6b-v2 into the catalog tomorrow. Targeting a 10:30 PT canary window. Need one eng + one QA to be available for smoke checks and rollback readiness. Who can take this?

mia: I can own the canary window. 10:30 PT works for me. I'll run the smoke runbook and watch the latency/cost dashboards.

ryan: I'll take QA. I'll run the eval suite and tokenizer checks. Plan to start prechecks at ~10:20 PT.

deploy-bot: Deployment notice: halcyon-6b-v2 scheduled for catalog canary. Suggested rollout: 5% -> 25% -> full (manual approve). Use: `/deploy catalog pin halcyon-6b-v2 --canary=5`

sam: Quick question on rollback: if regen-quality drops >5% on our conv eval, do we auto rollback to halcyon-6b-v1 or revert to the last pinned SHA?

nora: Manual rollback for this launch — revert to halcyon-6b-v1. I'm prepping the catalog PR with the pin + compatibility note: https://git.internal/r/redwood/catalog/pulls/1234. Also adding alerts: 95p latency >300ms and regen-quality drop >5%.

alex: Thanks Nora. Can you paste the pin snippet here so ops has it ready?

nora: ```json
{
  "model": "halcyon-6b",
  "version": "v2",
  "pin": "sha256:abc123def456ghi789",
  "rollout": {"canary": 5, "step": 20}
}
```

mia: I'll be in #eng-sre at 10:20 PT for infra smoke. Please ensure canary traffic is routed to test orgs only.

ryan: Prechecks complete: tokenizer matches, unit evals all pass, perf baseline within 2% of v1. No major output regressions on our prompt set. Ready for canary.

alex: OK go for deploy at 10:30 PT. Mia/Ryan/Nora on watch. If we hit alerts, trigger rollback and ping me immediately. :thumbsup:

nora: Noted. I'll post a post-smoke summary by 10:45 PT.

deploy-bot: Canary started — 5% traffic routed to halcyon-6b-v2. Monitoring: requests/sec, 95p latency, regen-quality score.

nora: Post-smoke update: after 15m at 5% -> 25% increase, metrics look stable. 95p latency 280ms, regen-quality +0.4% vs baseline. No regressions on curated prompts. Recommending move to full catalog pin pending final thumbs-up.

alex: Great job team — moving pin to catalog now. Thanks everyone for the quick turn. :party_parrot:
